introduction: SYNOPSISAe-ran wanders around after a heart-breaking break-up in college. Do-hyuk's friends assault Ae-ran with a pair of scissors. She begins to suffer from psychological problems from the shock of her attack. When she finds out that Do-hyuk lives in the same apartment as she does, she decides to destroy his happy home. Because of Ae-ran's threats, Do-hyuk has no choice but to lead a double life. Things come to a head when he runs into his wife in front of her doors. His wife Soo-hee wander around suffering from the shock of her husband's betrayal when a group of men assault her. She has a mental breakdown from the trauma. Enraged by what happens to his wife, Do-hyuk runs to Ae-ran's apartment and kills her with a pair of scissors and he himself meets a gruesome end himself.故事Elisa的被破心脏学院的疼痛强奸被用剪刀向dohyeok晚辈打，晚上在街上游荡。男性后果严重精神病aldeon她知道有一天dohyeok住在同一栋公寓，吃心脏摧毁danranhan dohyeok的家园。双重生活伊利莎的无情的恐吓dohyeok满足在公寓前你的妻子，有一天Elisa的。在流浪，晚上在街上不会错过一个令人失望的，是一个以强奸猥亵丈夫的风怒苏惠导致精神错乱。Dohyeok由他的妻子的出现激怒终于跑进公寓伊利莎剪刀杀死了她和自己打招呼可怕的结束。
